system.description:
When you would make an attack or cast a Jutsu affects a hostile creature, you can spend a superiority die to cripple a creature’s power.

One affected creature who would fail your Jutsu's saving throw gains 1 rank of Weakened. If your attack does not force a saving throw then affected creatures must make a Charisma Saving throw vs your Jutsu’s save DC (If Weapon/Unarmed, Taijutsu save DC). On a failed save, they suffer the effects previously stated.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.

roll.note: An attack or jutsu affecting a hostile creature: a creature failing the jutsu's save gains 1 rank of Weakened.

activities.label: Debilitate: Strength: Charisma save
activities.text: When the attack forces no save (Discipline already spent): a Charisma save (the jutsu's DC; Taijutsu for weapons or unarmed). Failure: 1 rank of Weakened.
